name: Is it possible to match new flooring with existing flooring in an older home?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to match new flooring with existing flooring in an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching new flooring with existing flooring in an older home can be challenging but is often achievable, especially with hardwood. For hardwood, factors like wood species, plank width, grain pattern, and finish need to be considered. Sometimes, existing hardwood can be refinished to match new additions. For other materials like tile or vinyl, finding an exact match might be difficult if the original product is discontinued. In such cases, a complementary transition or a different flooring in a new area might be a more practical and aesthetically pleasing solution. Our team can assess the feasibility of matching during an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Matching new to old flooring is challenging but possible, especially for hardwood by considering species, width, and finish. For other materials, complementary options may be best.
